flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for the batch, batch limits or sending Letters of Advice; only unused labels and path constants.
note: Synonyms tried across the six repos (UI and API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, court batch, batch_no, OIC, route, settled, executed, court letter. Only these were found: labels in translation.json (menu.occurences.letter_of_advice :122, letter_of_advice_list :123, court_batch_no :125, not used by any component), path constants in System.ts (COURT_BATCH_LIMIT :147, COURT_BATCH_DURATION, WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE :163) that no page uses and that have no backend resource, and a UI call to /v1/warrantofarrest (useSearch.ts:69-74) with no controller in any Java repo. The only backend court endpoint is CasIntegrationController (CAS-to-OCMS, not a Letter of Advice feature) and it is not credited: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. Story status is blank in the data (requirement not given); traced normally. No maintenance ticket matches (grep letter of advice / warrant / court batch = 0).
recommendation: Evidence 0%. Do not claim a Letter of Advice / batch / OIC routing feature; only UI labels and the general notice view exist.

steps.step: OCMS creates a Letter of Advice batch entry for the confirmed defendant and notice
steps.detail: There is no LOA batch entity, repository or service in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. Court Batch Limit is only a path constant (System.ts:147-150) with no page and no backend resource; court_batch_no is only a label (translation.json:125).

steps.step: Court batch size and duration limits are applied
steps.detail: Court Batch Limit/Duration are only path constants in System.ts:147-154 and in the TSystemAdminType type; there is no page, form or parameter read by the backend (grep court_batch in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi main = 0).

steps.step: Letter of Advice is sent to the defendant
steps.detail: There is no cron job/generator for LOA letters. The existing Toppan pipeline handles notice letters (stages such as DN/DR), not Letter of Advice (grep advice in ocmsadminprivateapi = only adviceSurcharge, a different field). The label 'List Letter of Advice' translation.json:123 is unused. The CAS endpoint is not credited.
